title: Comunidad Ukax Samart’añ Ururuw jan yäqasa
intro: Mä asentamiento costa ukar mantañamawa kawkhantix mä divin kamachix mä uru yupaychañataki ukat jark’aqasiñatakiw utt’ayata. Aka ayllunkir mä tamax uka kamachin límites ukanakap mä k’ari amtampiw yant’añ amtapxatayna, ukax mä mayjt’äwiruw puriyatayna, ukax walja maranakaw uñstañapäna. ¿Khitinakas uka almanakajj utjäna, ukat kunas jupanakar pasäna?
clues: Quta thiya jakʼanwa jakasipjjayäta, ukanwa lamar qotajj jakañatak yanaptʼapjjetäna.
Semanan mä uru jachʼañchapjjañajatakiw kamachipjjetäna, ukat akapachan lurañanakat sipansa yaqharuw apanukupjjerïta.
Uka uruxa, chawllanakax walpun jutapxitu, kamachi p’akintañatakis yant’apxirïtaspa ukhama.
Qullan urux janïr purinkipanx challwanak katjañatakiw mä amtar puripxta, ukat pasawayxasax apthapipxaraktwa.
Nanakasat yaqhepajj uka sallqjañ toqet ewjjtʼapjjetäna ukhajja, janiw ewjjtʼanakap istʼapkänti, jan jaytjasaw sarapjjayäta.
Jucha luratasatjja, mononakar tukuwaytanwa, jiskʼachatätanwa ukat jan yäqatätanwa.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
